events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, dying six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his tragic passing, Tupac Shakur's music and influence continue to resonate. What's your favourite track or lyric that still hits hard?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Remembering 56 years since his passing
events.blurb: Rock legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the world lost a true visionary. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar. What's the Hendrix track that showcases his genius best for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road: 57 years since its release
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: One of the most iconic album covers and tracklists ever! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped 57 years ago today. What's your go-to song from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Hynde's Distinctive Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have given us so many Pretenders classics. Which one is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite tune featuring that unmistakable voice?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine': 51 years since its UK release
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it was then. What does this album mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod: 25 years since its launch
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, and it began shipping on November 10, 2001, revolutionising how we listened to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got an iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed the game for portable music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, 007 has given us so much. What's your favourite Bond film or moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled impact of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary actor and comedian, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album": 58 years since its release
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the "White Album" – a sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track from this iconic double LP is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, the world fell silent for Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul': 61 years since its release
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Innovating Sound
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your top track from this classic?
